sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches. This is a chance for the leaders to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, with both sides needing points—Stafford are just two points behind leaders Sandbach, while Dawley sit mid-table. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in strong recent form, travel to Eccleshall (sixth place, currently on a run of wins), offering a genuine test of both teams' credentials. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals host struggling Wednesfield Community, before a midweek derby clash sees Brereton Social visit Wednesfield on Wednesday. Bilston Town (fifth, on a winning streak) make the trip to Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while Barnton travel to Shawbury United—the latter enduring a dire run of five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town host resurgent New Mills, and Cheadle Heath Nomads face a tough away visit to Telford Town. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a clash between struggling sides mid-table.
